visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with dark hair tied in pigtails sits cross-legged on a light brown surface behind a transparent glass barrier. Behind her is a light wooden door featuring a vertical red Lunar New Year decoration with black calligraphy. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the girl's face. She stares intently at a point on the glass barrier directly in front of the camera lens. Her expression is one of intense curiosity, with her mouth slightly puckered as she focuses. Her small hands remain firmly planted on the transparent surface. (3) The toddler maintains her position, looking slightly to the side and then back at the camera. Her facial expressions shift between focused observation and a slight smile. The indoor lighting is bright and even, highlighting her smooth skin and the texture of her sweatshirt. (4) The girl becomes more animated, opening her mouth wide as if shouting or making a sound. Her eyes are wide with excitement. For a brief moment, another young child wearing a face mask and a similar light-colored top appears in the background behind her on the left side of the frame before moving away. (5) The scene transitions to a solid pink background with a central cartoon illustration of the same little girl. Below the illustration, the white text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' is displayed in a clean, sans-serif font, serving as a branded outro card for the video.
